problem_type: A bounded model-facing projection can omit entries without an explicit, actionable ledger
symptom: When a send-time selection exceeds the transient model budget, a partial handle list could look complete.
direct_cause: The projection owner used a no-read longest-prefix fallback that could remove entries without a stable per-kind count or next action.
class_root: A bounded projection lacked one shared accounting boundary: every emitted prefix must carry total, listed, omitted, omittedByKind and an actionable instruction for the omitted suffix.
affected_population: Any message-scoped selection whose compact projection exceeds 6000 characters
Mixed document, canvas, timeline, reference and future handle kinds
Any desktop Agent turn that tries to recover omitted handles after the UI selection changes

external_sources.purpose: Opaque cursor, server page size, nextCursor completion and invalid cursor behavior
Agent-oriented tool boundaries, high-signal results, pagination/filtering, actionable errors and evaluation
Local run context is available to tools but is not automatically sent to the model
Reference read tool offset/limit continuation and truncation guidance

invariants: Projection lists the longest prefix that fits the 6000-character budget and always writes total, listed, omitted and omittedByKind for the omitted suffix.
total = listed + omitted and listed handles preserve snapshot order.
The fixed omitted note says the handles remain in the current selection and instructs the user to shrink or batch the selection.
Projection output is deterministic and valid JSON within the shared transient budget.

door_reduction.why_not: The two projection caller doors remain separate because one injects provider content and the other builds a compaction summary. The registration, declaration and transport doors remain separate in the full PR diff because each owns a distinct capability or profile boundary; the obsolete snapshot read execution door was deleted.

generality_proof: Every bounded send-time projection passes through projectAgentContextSnapshot/formatAgentContextSnapshot. The shared encoder computes the longest fitting prefix and the omitted suffix ledger for every handle kind, so future producers cannot silently drop entries through a separate read or kind-specific branch.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own the single budget ladder, longest-prefix selection, omittedByKind accounting and actionable note.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Uses formatAgentContextSnapshot for every provider-bound desktop message.
Uses the same projection owner for compaction summaries.
Produces handles consumed by the shared projection; it does not encode a second model-facing list.

recurrence.reason: Any future handle producer or larger mixed selection can exceed the projection budget; any desktop turn can have its live UI selection changed after send, so only a message-bound page read preserves semantics.
same_class_scan: node scripts/door-map.mjs formatAgentContextSnapshot: two projection caller doors
rg AgentContextSnapshot electron src: resident and domain producers converge on the shared projection
rg omittedByKind electron src tests: accounting assertions cover provider and resident consumers

prevention.invariant: The shared owner emits the longest prefix that fits, with total = listed + omitted, per-kind omitted counts and a fixed instruction to shrink or batch the selection.
prevention.failure_mode: Budget overflow emits a truthful prefix and an omitted ledger; it never implies that the prefix is the whole selection.
prevention.strategy: Delete the snapshot paging capability and its lane dispatch; keep one compact row encoder and compute omittedByKind from the omitted suffix at the shared projection boundary.

legacy_paths.rationale: The temporary read_selection declaration, cursor paging functions and dedicated performance fixtures are absent from the final tree; the final diff retains no callable legacy path.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Internal projection contract; no third-party runtime controls it.

migration: No snapshot format or stored data changes. Existing messages are re-projected through the shared longest-prefix encoder; omitted entries are reported with counts and a user action instead of a paging tool.
residual_risks: The model cannot inspect omitted handles in the same turn; users must shrink or batch the selection until the deferred tool-group decision is implemented.
The separate live look_at_canvas result has its own node-list budget and is outside this change.
Real-model accuracy for the updated omitted note remains unverified until the coordinator runs the approved sample.
